description: This file defines a React component named 'Invoices' that displays a paginated table of invoice data, including functionalities for editing, deleting, and viewing invoices. It uses Material-UI components, Redux for state management, and React Router for navigation.

classes.name: TablePaginationActions
classes.description: A React component providing custom pagination controls for the invoices table.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Returns style object based on invoice status ('Partial', 'Paid', 'Unpaid').

methods.name: toCommas
methods.description: Formats a number with commas as thousand separators.

methods.name: editInvoice
methods.description: Navigates to the invoice editing page for a given invoice ID.

methods.name: openInvoice
methods.description: Navigates to the invoice detail page for a given invoice ID.
